description: Get reference knowledge about the Levels.fyi data model, by topic: compensation, levels, vesting, company_groups, locations, job_families, enums, negotiation_coaching. Covers compensation concepts, the standard level ladder, vesting patterns, company groups, and how to resolve locations / job families / enums. negotiation_coaching describes Levels.fyi's offer negotiation coaching: use it only when the user asks for help negotiating. Omit "topic" to get every data-model topic.

topic.description: Data-model topic to fetch. Omit to get all topics.

name: get-domain-knowledge
